title: 第1789章 突然发现的坑洞第1788章 蚩魂族离豁然
content_zh:
“既然如此，那就麻烦离道友了。”
听见对方这么说，松业林只得爽快的拱手答应。
毕竟自己的安危才是最重要的，没必要逞强。
“其他道友还有什么疑问吗？”
“没有，麻烦离道友为我遮蔽灵魂之力。”
众人快速摇了摇头。
“好。”
离豁然接着便施展了一道术法，大折魂术。
在松业林几人的感知中，自己体内的灵魂仿佛被笼罩上一层纱衣，使他们对四周的感应出现了些许迟钝。
但这种感受不深，不至于影响到他们出手。
咦？
他的灵魂之力看似不强大，但竟然远比一般修士坚实........
是修炼过灵魂相关的秘法吗？？
不愧是难得一见的双十杰，手段隐藏的如此之深........
离豁然在施展术法的过程中敏锐察觉到叶非凡的不同之处，但好在叶非凡的灵魂之力只是坚实，并不强大，所以她的术法并未受到什么影响。
“诸位道友，可以了。
我这道术法不仅仅可以帮你们遮蔽灵魂气息，甚至还能些微为你们抵挡一点敌方针对的灵魂攻势。
不过它也是有时效的，会随着时间的流逝而消散。
所以诸位请不要离我太远，方便我及时补充。”
离豁然再次强调了一嘴，同时也是暗示众人自己的重要性。

“嗯，多谢离道友。
我们明白。”
松业林点点头。
“出发吧。”
接着离豁然带头朝着东侧方向飞了过去。
..........
离魂岛四周的一片区域完全就是无人区，根本看不见圣魂教的半个城镇，也无任何修士的踪影。
在之前双方还算和平相处的时候，圣魂教当然不希望让自己名下的蚩魂族距离离魂岛太近，那样无疑是给对方散播危险思想的机会。
而对于离魂岛来说，附近没有蚩魂族的修士便代表自己暂时不必时刻面对圣魂教的威胁，也是乐得见到这样。
当然，这对于那些自主想要脱离圣魂教掌控的修士来说就没那么方便了。
不过这也是没办法的事情，炎阳至尊本就不是为了拯救蚩魂族的修士而来。
一个半时辰后，蚩生魂界的天空完全暗了下来，两轮明月一大一小的挂在天空上为地面提供一定量的照明。
“离道友，我们飞行了这么久，连一个圣魂教修士的身影都没看到，并且下方的地面上似乎也没有任何特殊的迹象。
content_en:
"In this case, I'll trouble you, fellow Taoist Li."
Hearing what the other party said, Song Yelin had no choice but to readily agree.
After all, your own safety is the most important thing, there is no need to show off.
"Do other fellow Taoists have any questions?"
"No, please help fellow Taoist Li shield the power of his soul for me."
Everyone shook their heads quickly.
"Okay."
Li Huoran then performed a technique, the Great Soul-Breaking Technique.
In the perception of Song Yelin and others, the souls in their bodies seemed to be shrouded in a layer of gauze, making their perception of the surroundings slightly dull.
But this feeling is not deep and will not affect their actions.
Huh?
His soul power may not seem strong, but it is actually far stronger than ordinary monks...
Have you ever practiced soul-related secrets? ?
He is indeed one of the rare top ten heroes, with his methods hidden so deeply...
Li Huoran was keenly aware of the difference in Ye Feifan during the process of casting the spell, but fortunately, Ye Feifan's soul power was only solid, not powerful, so her spell was not affected.
"Fellow Taoists, that's it.
This technique of mine can not only help you cover your soul aura, but can even slightly resist the enemy's soul attack for you.
However, it is also time-limited and will dissipate over time.
So please don’t stay too far away from me so that I can make timely additions. "
Li Huoran emphasized again, and at the same time, he also hinted at his own importance.
"Well, thank you, Fellow Daoist Li.
We understand. "
Song Yelin nodded.
"Let's go."
Then Li Huanran took the lead and flew towards the east direction.
...........
The area around Lihun Island was completely no man's land. Half of the town of the Holy Soul Sect could not be seen at all, and there was no trace of any monks.
When the two sides were living in peace before, the Holy Soul Sect certainly didn't want the Chihun clan under its name to get too close to Lihun Island. That would undoubtedly give the other party an opportunity to spread dangerous ideas.
For Lihun Island, the fact that there are no monks from the Chihun clan nearby means that it does not have to face the threat of the Holy Soul Cult all the time for the time being, and it is happy to see this.
Of course, this is not so convenient for those monks who want to escape the control of the Holy Soul Religion.
But there is nothing that can be done about it. The Yanyang Supreme is not here to save the monks of the Chihun Clan.
An hour and a half later, the sky in Chisheng Soul Realm completely darkened, and two bright moons, one big and one small, hung in the sky to provide a certain amount of illumination for the ground.
"Fellow Daoist Li, we have been flying for so long, and we haven't even seen a single Holy Soul Cult monk, and there doesn't seem to be any special sign on the ground below.
